$schema.description: Source-owned judgments for the C-prime AgentOS extraction inventory.
$schema.runtimeProbeEligibility: eligible means import and eager evaluation settle safely inside the disposable denial child; ineligible rows name the exact unguarded or external-work boundary
$schema.manifestAuthority: launch-root targets and package declarations are exact identity populations; every package row names explicit engine/edge/cloud/shared manifestTargets and never relies on workspace hoisting
$schema.consumerEdgeAuthority: consumerEdges reconcile both outside-to-AgentOS and Edge-reached AgentOS-to-outside imports; line numbers are evidence while source/kind/specifier/target/ordinal form stable identity
$schema.consumerSourceClassAuthority: source classes already owned by AgentOS through an independent project/custody contract are one exact registry row, never thousands of internal-import rows
$schema.engineDependencyCovenant: the Engine carries no AgentOS package in dependencies or devDependencies; exact forbidden package names are source-owned below
$schema.workflowFileDispositionAuthority: every workflow file with an AgentOS artifact occurrence has exactly one repository-cut action: move, pin-fetch, or retire; occurrence plane custody never chooses the file action
